summary: Datacentrex, Inc. filed an 8-K/A solely to correct the item number under which a prior press release was reported, moving it from Item 2.02 to Item 8.01. The press release announces the company has secured colocation capacity to deploy over 500 additional ElphaPex DG2 Scrypt ASIC miners, which were fully prepaid in 2025, requiring no incremental capital. Deployment is expected within 30 days, increasing hashrate by about 21%. This is routine operational news, not a special situation. No M&A, tender offer, or strategic event is involved; the filing is a corrective amendment only.
